top_signals.title: Rio Tinto and China State Buyer Agree Deal on Iron Ore Supplies
top_signals.summary: China’s state-backed iron ore buyer and Rio Tinto Group have reached a multiyear agreement on supplies of the steel-making staple, adding to deals that the group has struck with leading global producers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
